sinopsis.es: Una mujer comprende la transición de su hijo acercándose a otro chico trans de su pueblo. En él ve un reflejo de lo que su hijo podría alcanzar si se sintiera validado y reconocido. Este termina siendo un puente para conectarse nuevamente con su familia y consigo misma.
sinopsis.en: A woman comes to understand her son's transition after meeting a young trans man from her small town. In him, she sees a reflection of what her son could aspire to be if he had more confidence. This experience ultimately serves as a bridge for her to reconnect with her family and with herself.
